description: EPH-02 CRITICAL PRE-EXECUTION SIMULATION GATEWAY for Flashloans & MEV routes on Base (ChainID 8453). Executes read-only EVM sandbox tracing before broadcasting real arbitrage or swap routes to mainnet. Detects hidden reverts, slippage traps, fee-on-transfer hooks, and gas bombs. Zero host OS privilege, strictly memory-isolated. Charges 1.50 USDC via x402 on Base. Clients that cannot send _meta may pass payment_method ('points' or 'onchain'), invoice_id, signature and (for on-chain) tx_hash as arguments instead. Supply payer_address. For redemption pass invoice_id and signature in _meta.x402/payment, with tx_hash for on-chain payment or method=points where supported. Settlement errors set isError and _meta.x402/payment-error.status_code; 503 indicates admission unavailable, while a 409 uncertain outcome must not be automatically retried.

payer_address.description: Payer wallet for invoice creation and redemption

payment_method.description: Settlement rail. 'points' spends membership points; 'onchain' verifies tx_hash.

signature.description: EIP-191 signature over challengeToSign by payer_address.

tx_hash.description: Base mainnet USDC transfer hash for on-chain settlement.

name: simulate_mev_route_safety
